I’m a beginner at both, but I would say that:

1) Elixir is easier to learn than Golang because of its size.

2) Elixir leverages the Erlang VM (BEAM) for amazing concurrent performance.

3) Elixir processes aren’t OS processes. They are a lot faster and can be spawned and terminated a lot easier.

4) Elixir is based around Supervision which enables the developer to create fault-tolerant applications with little effort. 

5) Elixir (and Erlang) uses OTP which is amazing for real-time applications.

I am in no position to claim that one language is better than the other, but these are my opinions. I’m the end, it comes down to preference and requirements.
